hooks.name: Backend tests when agent finishes
hooks.description: When an agent run ends with uncommitted backend changes, run the backend tests offline in fallback mode.

action.command: cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)" && if git status --porcelain -- backend mcp_server tests/backend | grep -q .; then DRAINFAST_FALLBACK=1 "$( [ -x .venv/bin/python ] && echo .venv/bin/python || echo python )" -m pytest tests/backend -q -p no:warnings; fi
